# Promote the 850 VESUM-attested Ohoiko/ULP lemmas into the Atlas (#6370, parent #4220/#4387)

ROUTING_CARD_V1
- tier: practical
- model_x_harness: (driver fills at dispatch — catalog-data seam must be free, i.e. after
  atlas-reenrich-delta-merge lands)
- why_this_tier: bounded promotion through existing enrich/anchor tooling; measurement already
  done and ledgered
- owned_paths: scripts/atlas/** (usage), catalog data artifacts
- acceptance_cmd: pytest (affected) + ruff + existing publish/QG gate
- alternatives_considered: (filled at dispatch)
- parallel_free_seats: (filled at dispatch)

## Evidence preamble (#M-4)
Re-derive every count locally (the ledger may be stale after the delta-merge lands). Ukrainian
lemma validity: VESUM / sources MCP verified — CODE decides validity, no LLM judging.

## Context
- Measurement of record (issue #6370 comment 2026-08-07): 1,084 inventory lemmas missing from
  Atlas; 850 `single_word_vesum_ok` promotion-ready; 218 paired-headword-comma; 12 multiword;
  1 OCR typo (`тваринa` with Latin 'a'); 3 heritage-flagged.
- Ledger: `batch_state/atlas-6370-ohoiko-residual.json` (re-derive before acting).
- The prior agy dispatch ended no_deliverable — nothing was promoted.

## Outcome wanted
The re-derived `single_word_vesum_ok` set is promoted through the STANDARD enrich/anchor path
(no raw injection — #5411 lesson), catalog gates green, PR opened with: promoted count,
per-category residual table (paired/multiword/typo/heritage stay OPEN and named), entry-count
delta quoted before/after.

## Steps
1. Dispatch worktree only. 2. Re-derive the residual against the CURRENT catalog (post
delta-merge). 3. Promote via existing tooling — if the standard path can't handle some subset,
that subset stays in the named residual; do NOT hand-inject. 4. pytest + ruff + publish gate.
5. Conventional commit + X-Agent trailer, push, PR referencing #6370/#4220/#4387. 6. NO
auto-merge. Report PR + counts + residual table.

## Non-goals
Paired-headword splitting policy (needs its own design decision), multiword phrases, the OCR
typo fix upstream — all named residual, separate follow-ups.
